title: External channel access request
subtitle: Review who may invoke this Agent from this external channel.
notFoundDescription: This link is invalid, unavailable to your account, or no longer exists.
unauthorizedDescription: Sign in with an authorized Azents account to review this request.
errorDescription: The request could not be loaded. Try again.
pendingDescription: This participant is waiting for an explicit access decision. No Agent session has been invoked yet.

completed.allowed: This request was approved. The participant can invoke the Agent within the granted scope.
completed.denied: This request was denied. It did not create access or invoke the Agent.
completed.blocked: This participant was blocked from creating future access requests for this Agent.
completed.expired: This request expired before a decision was made. It can no longer be approved.

actions.allowSessionDescription: Grant access only to the Session created for this Slack conversation.
actions.allowAgentDescription: Grant this participant access across this Agent’s eligible Slack conversations.
actions.denyDescription: Resolve this request without granting access.
actions.blockDescription: Deny this request and suppress future approval requests for this Agent.

errors.conflict: This request can no longer be completed. It may have expired, been decided elsewhere, or belong to a disconnected channel.
errors.action: The decision could not be saved. Try again.
